conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Supervised learning uses labeled data for training, while unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabelled data; reinforcement learning, in contrast, learns through interaction and feedback. Each approach suits different types of problems and data structures.
